svg.title: CausalSelfAttention.forward, lane by lane
svg.desc: Input splits into Query, Key and Value lanes. All three are projected. Value optionally gets a value residual. Query and Key get QK-norm then RoPE. Key and Value go through the KV cache. All three meet in the attention kernel, then gating, head merge and out_proj.

g.text: returns all past K and V
